en-US.name: SkyFrame
en-US.summary: Personal live aircraft radar reports for your home location.
en-US.description: SkyFrame reports live nearby aircraft using ADS-B data. Personal/developer-console skill, not published to the Alexa Skills Store.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask sky frame what planes are near me
Alexa, ask sky frame what planes are within 10 miles
